abstract: An 18-year-old man complaining of chest pain was admitted to our hospital. Contrast-enhanced chest computed tomography (CT) showed an anterior mediastinal tumor with patchy enhanced lesions in the peripheral and poorly-enhanced central areas. His serum alpha fetoprotein (AFP) level was high. FDG-PET imaging indicated intense FDG uptake in the mediastinal tumor (SUVmax was 11.2), but no other abnormal FDG uptake, including in his testes, was detected. CT-guided needle biopsy revealed necrotizing tissue, including immature cartilage-like tissue. Based on these clinical features, we diagnosed mixed-type germ cell tumor originating from the mediastinum. Bleomycin, etoposide and cisplatin combination chemotherapy was administered every 3 weeks, for 4 cycles. His serum AFP level declined during the treatment course, and the mediastinal tumor decreased in size. After 4 cycles of chemotherapy, the residual tumor was resected completely and no viable cells were detected in the resected tumor. Tumor recurrence has not been detected for more than 9 months after surgery without adjuvant chemotherapy at the time of writing.
abstract_ja: 胸痛を訴える18歳男性が入院した。造影胸部コンピュータ断層撮影（CT）で、周辺部に斑状の増強域、中心部に増強不良域を伴う前縦隔腫瘍が認められた。血清αフェトプロテイン（AFP）値は高値であった。FDG-PET検査では縦隔腫瘍に強いFDG集積（SUVmax 11.2）が認められたが、精巣を含め他に異常な集積はなかった。CT下針生検で、未熟な軟骨様組織を含む壊死組織が確認された。これらの臨床所見から、縦隔原発の混合型胚細胞腫瘍と診断した。ブレオマイシン、エトポシド、シスプラチンの併用化学療法を3週間ごとに4コース施行した。治療経過中に血清AFP値は低下し、縦隔腫瘍は縮小した。4コース終了後、残存腫瘍を完全切除し、切除標本では生存細胞は認められなかった。本論文執筆時点で、術後補助化学療法を行わずに9か月以上再発は確認されていない。
